release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD4237-25 is a thermal and optical bi-spectrum network speed dome (PTZ) pairing a 384x288 VOx thermal detector (25 mm lens) with a 2 MP 32x optical zoom channel. It supports temperature measurement (-20 to 150 C), fire detection and perimeter-protection analytics. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical is Channel 1 (Streaming/Channels/101), thermal is Channel 2 (Streaming/Channels/201).
